name: Gohoushi Bakunyuu Waitress ~Midara na Service~
original_name: ご奉仕爆乳ウェイトレス～淫らなサービス～
source:
Rina is a high school student and her first part time job is a waitress at a coffee shop. Actually that shop is a brothel. She does not know the fact but works hard with her face covered with semen.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305034954/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1003207]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
高中生高见里奈第一次外出打工，在一家咖啡店担任服务员。可那里其实是一间妓院。对此一无所知的她仍在拼命工作，脸上沾满了精液。

[内容取自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305034954/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1003207]Eroge Shop[/url]]
